description: Explains stratification, wind and Ekman transport, coastal upwelling, gyres, overturning circulation, Southern Ocean exchange, heat uptake, and what Argo floats and satellites measure.

related_resources.reason: California/Oregon/Washington upwelling, seasonal wind variability, cold nutrient-rich source water and biological production.
Wind, tides, and density differences as ocean-current drivers.
Surface wind-driven flow, Coriolis, vertical circulation, density-driven deep flow and topographic effects.
Western boundary intensification and the Gulf Stream as an example of western boundary circulation.
Ocean heat uptake, Southern Ocean exchange and water-mass formation, thermal expansion and observed sea-level change.
Observing-system strengths, vertical profiles and caveats about deep ocean, sea ice and coastal sampling.
Present-day energy flows; feedbacks including water vapor, cloud, ice and radiative forcing; uncertainty and ocean heat uptake.
Argo history, measurement depths, global temperature/salinity profiles and Deep Argo development.
Park-and-profile 10-day cycle, conductivity-temperature-pressure and satellite communication.
